subject: Chemistry
b6_reason: Both are true: aniline's lone pair binds AlCl3 to give a deactivated anilinium-type complex so Friedel-Crafts fails, and Gabriel synthesis cannot give aryl amines because aryl halides do not undergo SN2 with phthalimide anion.
b6_working: Statement I: NH2 + AlCl3 forms an acid-base complex, the nitrogen acquires positive charge and strongly deactivates the ring to electrophilic alkylation - true. Statement II: Gabriel synthesis needs an alkyl halide for nucleophilic substitution; aryl halides are inert to it, so aniline cannot be made this way - true. Both true.
